findings.text: follow-on: _scope_name_ids (loop.py:331) and its wiring at loop.py:2103-2111 carry the half of the reported defect's fix that decides which names a scoped run owns, and no test in the repository names it — grep -rn _scope_name_ids over tests/ returns nothing, and the node's own gate selection (tests/standard_names/test_source_refresh.py plus test_source_refresh_docs_requeue.py) never reaches loop.run_sn_pools. A regression that dropped sn_ids=_refresh_ids from the loop's call, or that made _scope_name_ids return the wrong set or None, would leave the whole suite green; only the refresh-side guard below the loop is measured.

follow-on: test_scoped_refresh_never_steers_a_name_outside_its_scope drives the _ScopeGraph double (tests/standard_names/test_source_refresh.py:218), a double that filters its rows on the sn_ids kwarg the code under test itself passes — so the test cannot fail if the AND sn.id IN $sn_ids clause is deleted from the Cypher, and it guards only that refresh_drifted_sources forwards sn_ids. Its own docstring at line 209 claims the scoping 'is exercised rather than assumed', which the double makes true of the python plumbing and not of the query. The clause itself is guarded by the graph-marked test_scoped_drift_scan_touches_only_the_runs_names, so this misattributes no risk, but a reader crediting this test with the query guard is crediting the wrong one.

follow-on: the graph-arm receipt's own first line reads '# revision: c5b7f76ed429c79ee4797a2b202e3e9985a85e8e' — the base commit names HEAD at run time, because the log was written at 07:06 before de6532dbb was committed at 07:07:34, while the tree it measured already carried the head source and the five new graph tests. The manifest's test_logs calls this log 'head', which it is, but the log cannot be matched to reviewed_head_sha by anything this reader can check; a receipt whose first line names a revision it did not run at is the substitution the run's own gate-header rule forbids. The same arm is corroborated under a correct header by logs/gate-head-default-markers.log (de6532dbb) and the negative control, so the count of 5 passed EXIT=0 is not in doubt.

follow-on: _scope_name_ids catches every Exception and returns [] 'best-effort scoping, never fatal' (loop.py:360-362), which also swallows the RuntimeError that tests/standard_names/conftest.py:139 raises when a default-tier test opens a live GraphClient. Loop-level tests that set scope_run_id (for example tests/standard_names/test_scoped_global_maintenance.py:198) therefore now attempt a real connection inside run_sn_pools without failing, silently reading sn_ids=[]; the structural guard that exists to catch exactly that attempt is defeated on this one path. Production is arguably right to fail closed, but the guard's signal is a test-isolation fact and is invisible here.

follow-on: the source-creation Cypher in _attach_source ends with a no-op `""".replace("{id: $name_id)", "{id: $name_id)")` — the same string in and out, so the call reads as a repair while repairing nothing. Dead code in a new helper; remove it or state what it guards.

VERDICT goal: the node's goal is to bind the source-drift refresh to the run's own name set and to correct three smaller defects in the same module; the landed diff does all four — source_refresh.py:280 adds `AND sn.id IN $sn_ids`, source_refresh.py:336 makes `renamed` a RENAMED_TO verdict, source_refresh.py:317 reports the unresolvable source into `unchecked`, and source_refresh.py:245-340 groups rows per name and reports the name drifted when any source has, with loop.py:2103-2111 resolving and passing the run's set.
VERDICT done_when: the four done-when items are met and recorded — the change and tests are committed (de6532dbb code, 677c9aaef evidence), the gate shows no added failures (base 13 passed EXIT=0 in logs/gate-base-default-markers.log against head 18 passed EXIT=0 in logs/gate-head-default-markers.log), the disposable-Neo4j and negative-control logs are kept (logs/gate-head.log 5 passed EXIT=0, logs/negative-control.log 1 failed EXIT=1), and docs/evidence/fragments/sn-harmonize-command/shc-drift-refresh-scope-fix.html records each fix before and after and names the graph_ops.py re-stamp as left for a later node.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares imas_codex/standard_names/source_refresh.py, imas_codex/standard_names/loop.py, tests/standard_names/test_source_refresh.py and the evidence fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/sn-harmonize-command/; git diff c5b7f76ed..677c9aaef changes exactly those four files and nothing else.
VERDICT manifest: read at the current revision; status complete, commits de6532dbb and 677c9aaef named, the four fixes and the gate recorded in the checkpoint and landing lines, negative_control_log a single bare path, and the fragment's element ids all prefixed with the node id; its test_logs line labels logs/gate-head.log as head while that log's own header names c5b7f76ed (see the finding).
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against c5b7f76ed; de6532dbb carries the code (source_refresh.py rewritten to per-source resolution and per-name grouping, loop.py gaining _scope_name_ids and the sn_ids wiring) and 677c9aaef adds only the 214-line evidence fragment, so the measured content and the reviewed head differ by documentation alone.
CALL_SITES: imas_codex/standard_names/loop.py:2095-2111 (run_sn_pools, the only production caller of refresh_drifted_sources), imas_codex/standard_names/source_refresh.py:419-491 (refresh_drifted_sources, the only production caller of detect_source_drift and _format_reason)
SCORE goal_fidelity: 18
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: all four briefed fixes are present and reachable — the scope filter at imas_codex/standard_names/source_refresh.py:280, the lineage-decided rename at source_refresh.py:336, the unchecked report at source_refresh.py:317 and the per-name multi-source grouping at source_refresh.py:245-340 — and loop.py:2103-2111 threads the run's set in, with the unscoped path left graph-wide as the brief requires.
SCORE evidence: 15
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the done-when's measure is asserted by the gate the node ran and its results are recorded rather than claimed (logs/gate-base-default-markers.log 13 passed EXIT=0 versus logs/gate-head-default-markers.log 18 passed EXIT=0, no added failure id), but the graph-arm receipt at logs/gate-head.log:1 names the base commit in its own `# revision:` header while measuring head content, and the loop-side change is by the brief's selection unmeasured.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: git diff c5b7f76ed429c79ee4797a2b202e3e9985a85e8e..677c9aaef2cc9df43882129c7f3d765e37093246 changes only the four declared write paths and within imas_codex/standard_names/source_refresh.py disturbs nothing but the drift functions the brief names.
SCORE durability: 13
JUSTIFICATION durability: the added tests are real guards in the graph-marked arm — removing the AND sn.id IN $sn_ids clause reddens tests/standard_names/test_source_refresh.py:610 as logs/negative-control.log records — but the loop-side fix has no test at all (no test names _scope_name_ids, loop.py:331) and the python-side scope test at tests/standard_names/test_source_refresh.py:255 drives a double that filters on the code's own sn_ids argument and so cannot fail on the query regression it appears to cover.
SCORE fit: 17
JUSTIFICATION fit: the change follows the module's idiom — module-level Cypher constants (_RESOLVE_SOURCE_TERMINAL beside _RESOLVE_TERMINAL), the existing _norm/_norm_ids comparators, and the fail-soft `except Exception  # noqa: BLE001` shape already used by _count_scope_names at imas_codex/standard_names/loop.py:320 — and introduces no plan or ticket identifier in source, but tests/standard_names/test_source_refresh.py:558 keeps a no-op .replace whose two arguments are identical.
SCORE reuse: 18
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the added definitions extend an existing owner and duplicate nothing — _scope_name_ids (loop.py:331) generalises _count_scope_names (loop.py:297), which already owns the 'names bound to a run id' query and returns 0 on error as this returns [], _source_deltas extracts the field-by-field comparison that already lived inline in detect_source_drift, and a repository search for another owner of StandardNameSource.run_id scoping (grep over imas_codex/ finds none) confirms the source half is new rather than a fork.
FINDING imas_codex/standard_names/loop.py:331 follow-on: _scope_name_ids and its wiring at loop.py:2103-2111 carry the half of the fix that decides which names a scoped run owns, and no test in the repository names it (grep -rn _scope_name_ids tests/ returns nothing), so a regression that dropped sn_ids=_refresh_ids from the call or returned the wrong set would leave the suite green.
FINDING tests/standard_names/test_source_refresh.py:255 follow-on: test_scoped_refresh_never_steers_a_name_outside_its_scope drives the _ScopeGraph double at line 218, which filters rows on the sn_ids kwarg the code under test itself passes, so the test cannot fail if the AND sn.id IN $sn_ids clause is deleted from the Cypher — it guards the python plumbing only, while its docstring at line 209 claims the scoping 'is exercised rather than assumed'.
FINDING /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261023T043245792140-shc-drift-refresh-scope-fix/logs/gate-head.log:1 follow-on: the graph-arm receipt's first line names revision c5b7f76ed429c79ee4797a2b202e3e9985a85e8e, the base commit rather than the head tree it measured, so the log cannot be matched to the reviewed head by its own header even though the manifest calls it 'head'.
FINDING imas_codex/standard_names/loop.py:360 follow-on: the broad except in _scope_name_ids also swallows the RuntimeError that tests/standard_names/conftest.py:139 raises when a default-tier test opens a live GraphClient, so loop-level tests that set scope_run_id (e.g. tests/standard_names/test_scoped_global_maintenance.py:198) now attempt a real connection and pass silently with sn_ids=[].
